highlights: CCTV in operation at all times on campus in certain locations
Photographic ID required at the entrance / Visitor Identification
Aligned with UN Convention on the Rights of the Child and UK Keeping Children Safe in Education guidance
safety.policy_summary: BISP treats safeguarding and child protection as a top priority, aligning its policies with Thai law, the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, and UK statutory guidelines ('Keeping Children Safe in Education'). The school enforces strict visitor codes of conduct, requires photographic identification, operates CCTV surveillance in certain locations, and appoints Designated Safeguarding Leads (DSLs) to handle disclosures and student welfare.
